actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined immune/inflammatory identity (allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma, IL6-JAK-STAT3 up-regulation with moderate-to-large effect sizes and FDR significance) plus a strong FDR-significant BAP1 enrichment (OR 20.55). Membership is structurally compatible, no measured technical factor provides a dominant alternative explanation (all confound tests non-significant), and the structural evidence does not positively support a Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
